title: SpeakingEvaluationFailedPayload
description: Payload emitted when an IELTS Speaking evaluation encounter an error or audio corruption issue.

attemptId.description: Unique identifier of the failed speaking attempt.

errorCode.description: Canonical machine-readable error code (e.g. AUDIO_DOWNLOAD_FAILED, CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, SILENT_AUDIO_DETECTED).

isRetriable.description: Indicates whether the message can be safely re-queued to the retry topic.

failedAt.description: Timestamp when the failure occurred (ISO-8601 UTC).
